t: What YugabyteDB Engine Is All About
title: What YugabyteDB Engine Is All About
description: Postgres-compatible distributed SQL on a DocDB core: planet-scale RDBMS.. This database covers YugabyteDB Engine with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Every database engine makes the same fundamental tradeoffs between read speed, write speed, and space amplification.
definition: YugabyteDB Engine — Postgres-compatible distributed SQL on a DocDB core: planet-scale RDBMS.
key_points: Every database engine makes the same fundamental tradeoffs between read speed, write speed, and space amplification.
The storage engine determines the ceiling; the SQL layer determines the ergonomics.
MVCC lets readers proceed without blocking writers, which is why modern OLTP scales.
Write-ahead logging is non-negotiable for durability; every serious engine has one.

title: DocDB core
description: DocDB core. DocDB is a distributed document store on RocksDB with Raft per tablet. Tables shard into tablets that split under load and replicate across zones. The YSQL layer compiles Postgres SQL onto DocDB.
